name: ai-orchestration
description: Protocol-agnostic Architect/Executor orchestration and task-pipeline skills — works for both Single-Framework Native (Kilo-only / Claude-only with parallel native worktrees/subagents) and Multi-Framework MCP delegation

plugins.name: task-pipeline
plugins.description: Author and maintain a durable, resumable development pipeline as a tasks/ tree (initiatives, specs, emergent tasks, and state registry)

plugins.name: orchestration-workflow
plugins.description: Orchestrate Executor agents using discovery-first and non-blocking delegation

plugins.name: orchestration-metrics
plugins.description: Evaluate delegation efficiency and ROI analysis

plugins.name: conflict-resolver
plugins.description: Resolve merge conflicts produced by parallel Executor tasks

plugins.name: task-spec-authoring
plugins.description: Write Executor task specs and calibrate verification depth, regardless of dispatch path

plugins.name: task-worktree-ops
plugins.description: Manual git-worktree mechanics for handing tasks to an Executor and interacting with its live worktree

plugins.name: executor-contract
plugins.description: Behavioral contract for an Executor agent running background tasks

plugins.name: orchestration-setup
plugins.description: Maps the kit's abstract role profiles to whatever models/hosts you actually have and configures orchestration.toml
